criteria.text: Calculates the long-stop date as 6 October 2026 (120 days after signing on 8 June 2026) and identifies that expected clearance on 20 November 2026 falls after it, recommending an extension.

Identifies the conflict between the 20-day claim notice period in SPA Section 9.7 and the 45-day period in Escrow Clause 5.2, and recommends the Buyer works to the shorter 20-day period or aligns the documents.

Identifies that the core platform was developed by contractor Kingsmere Industries Ltd without a written IP assignment, so the Company may not own it, and recommends obtaining a confirmatory assignment as a condition to Closing.
Gives the long-stop period as 120 days and as the date 6 October 2026, with days remaining from 24 June 2026 (104 days).
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
Checks whether computed deadlines fall on a weekend and adjusts them under the documents' Business Day definition.
